import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Plot a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between income and spending behavior
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='MntWines', data=data)
sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='MntFruits', data=data, color='red')

plt.title('Spending Behavior by Income')
plt.xlabel('Income')
plt.ylabel('Spending Amount')
plt.legend(['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat Products', 'Fish Products'])
